name: johnny-suede-design
description: Suede Labs AI full-stack surface builder that runs design, copy, and visual QA as one pass: landing pages, brand surfaces, product UI, dashboards, campaigns, launch pages, and reference-to-target restyles (suedify). Use when a build needs layout and words together, when a redesign or launch surface has to ship end to end, when the request is 'make this site look like that one', or when design, copy, asset, and QA lanes have to move at once. NOT FOR: a design-token, dark-mode, or single-component
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一款把设计、文案和视觉质检一次完成的 AI 页面构建工具，适合端到端制作网站、产品界面及参考样式改版。
